`create_model` computes `flat_snapshots` and uses it to flatten `n.model.parameters`, but never converts `sns` itself. For a multi-period network with `"flat"` (or `"auto"` under v1 semantics), the variable and constraint builders—including both transmission-loss builders—still receive the original MultiIndex; the component-data context does not change those arguments.
